name: Righteous Zeal
text: Fervour drives this unit onward: it may roll its Charge dice again whenever the first result disappoints.

name: Righteous Zeal
text: Fervour drives this unit onward: it may roll its Advance dice again whenever the first result disappoints.

name: Patrol Squads
text: When battle formations are declared, before anything is set up, this squad may divide into two separate units of five models. Each half keeps every ability the squad had.

name: Assault Vehicle
text: Passengers may leave this transport in a turn where it Advanced. A unit that does so counts as having made a Normal move and cannot declare a charge that turn. Disembarking after a Fall Back remains forbidden.
